title: Design System: Educational ABG Tutor & Clinical Analysis Suite

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Apple HIG styled primary action button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #007AFF; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0056B3; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Clinical Card
components.description: White surface card with subtle border and elevation
components.html:
Arterial Blood Gas Parameters

Enter bedside laboratory values for automated diagnostic analysis.
components.css: .ds-card-clinical { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E5E5EA; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); } .ds-card-title { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #1C1C1E; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-card-text { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #6C6C70; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: The Educational ABG Tutor & Clinical Analysis Suite is crafted in the Apple Medical Clean aesthetic: serene, authoritative, pristine, and functionally transparent.
keyCharacteristics: Apple Medical Clean visual vocabulary: ultra-legible typography, subtle depth, high contrast, and neutral canvas.
Clean, non-distracting motion with exponential deceleration curves.

rules.name: The Single-Purpose Accent Rule
rules.body: Color is reserved exclusively for interactive states and diagnostic status.

rules.name: The 11px Legibility Floor Rule
rules.body: Functional UI text and medical parameter labels must never fall below 11px.

rules.name: The Zero-Glow Halo Rule
rules.body: Zero-offset colored box-shadows or text-shadow glows are strictly banned.

dos: Do maintain WCAG AA contrast ratio (≥ 4.5:1 for body copy).
Do use SF Pro / Apple system font hierarchy.
Do enforce exponential smooth easing curve.
donts: Don't use colored border-left or border-right accent stripes (> 1px) on cards.
Don't add pulsing status dot animations.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing.
